description: Env SAFETY policy for Connect AI. This is NOT a feature for reading values. It defines what may be read, and what must NEVER be output, across adapters AND all Connect AI surfaces (Output Channel, Markdown reports, webview, logs).

threeLayerProtection.1_readDeny: Never read forbidden vars or forbiddenFiles at all.
threeLayerProtection.2_redaction: Even allowed-to-read vars are masked as '***' in every output surface. Forbidden vars are masked unconditionally.
threeLayerProtection.3_approvalGate: Any adapter run() that would pass env to a child process requires user approval (approvalRequiredForRun).

handling.maskedRepresentation: only { name, exists: bool, value: '***' } — raw value never leaves this boundary

conditionalAllow.rule: Allowed ONLY if the name contains none of forbiddenNameWords. Otherwise deny.

connect-ai.forbiddenNote: No external API keys, payment keys, or OAuth tokens.

job-search.forbiddenNote: credentials.json, google_token.json, Gmail/Sheets OAuth tokens are forbidden (read + print).

stock-research.forbiddenNote: KIS, broker, account, order, token, appsecret, live-trading vars forbidden. Treat even the EXISTENCE of these vars as sensitive — do not report exists:true for them.

ai-tool-research.forbiddenNote: Keyed search API keys forbidden: Tavily, Exa, Perplexity, SerpAPI.

digital-nomad.forbiddenNote: YouTube OAuth, Google API, AdSense, PayPal secrets forbidden.

youtube-intelligence.forbiddenNote: YouTube OAuth, Google API tokens forbidden.

notes: Designed by Claude (brain). readableAllow is intentionally narrow — add real vars only when a concrete need appears. Codex reviews, then selectively migrates into antigravity-projects/connect-ai/config/env-policy.json and enforces layers 2-3 in the loader + Output/redaction layer.
